Class AbstractCPUContext

java.lang.Object
net.emustudio.emulib.plugin.cpu.AbstractCPUContext
All Implemented Interfaces:
Context, CPUContext
@ThreadSafe public abstract class AbstractCPUContext extends Object implements CPUContext
Abstract CPU context.

Implements passed cycles listeners management
